**3.6h**

This was an extremely long session of finishing of my Starbie! It may not seem like a lot for experienced hardware experts, but I worked 3 straight hours on finishing up my schematics. Finally, I found out some really cool tips on how to route my PCB through YouTube (Youtube really is your friend in Hardware ^-^),  cleaned up errors, and started on some Arduino code :DDD

### 2026-10-11 – FINISHED OFF MY STARBIEEE!!!

**1.33h**

FINISHED OFF MY STARBIEEE!!!
Huge milestone in my eyes, I was working so hard on this, if this gets approved this may be my first hardware project ever. Honestly, I really gave myself a pat on the back for this one :DDD

I finished up the Arduino code and Gerber files (like 20 mins from the end of week 1 T-T), and I uploaded it all to Github. Hooray!!

**1.48h**

I said I finished my Starbie in my last journal entry, -- which I did, but this part was a whole lot of budgeting and exporting files from KiCad + updating my Github repo. I forgot to lapse this, so I ended up not lapsing at all, just to remember that I could've lapsed a bit then added the extra time manually T-T

I revised my ReadMe, uploaded a BOM from KiCad, revised my BOM in HalfLife (through HEAVY budgeting efforts and scouring through sites), added a picture to my ReadMe, added a sort of duplicate BOM to my ReadMe, and important details for shipping in my ReadMe as well.
